entities.summary: Rihards Bukarts is a Latvian professional ice hockey player who is a forward for HC Prešov of the Slovak Extraliga. Bukarts was selected ninth overall in the 2012 KHL Junior Draft by Dinamo Riga. With the selection, Bukarts became the highest-drafted Latvian in KHL history, four spots higher than his brother Roberts Bukarts in 2009.
